title: Denmark – Pharmaceutical products – Amgros 2027 1.1452.a
description: Amgros I/S (Amgros) er et interessentskab med de 5 regioner som interessenter. Amgros ønsker at indgå rammeaftaler for de lægemidler, der fremgår af de enkelte delkontrakter nedenfor, med henblik på at forsyne interessenternes sygehusapoteker med lægemidler samt eventuelt videresalg til Færøerne og Grønland. Amgros videresælger lægemidlerne til sygehusapotekerne til Amgros’ indkøbspris med et tillæg. Rammeaftalerne er ikke-eksklusive. Rammeaftalerne indgås uden købspligt, og sygehusapotekerne i regionerne er ikke forpligtet til at anvende Amgros’ rammeaftaler.

title: PROPAGATION MODELS FOR THE CLUTTER LOSS IN FREQUENCY SHARING ANALYSIS EXPRO+
description: Objective: To develop propagation models and improve their applicability for clutter loss on terrestrial and Earth-space paths to frequency sharing methods used by ESA and European frequency managers.Description: The development of terrestrial 5G systems has ledto the developments and updates of propagation models for what regards the effect of clutter on interference with space services andwith other Earth stations. The initial development done in ITU-R SG3 and in past TDE activities (ref. no. T507-601EF) focused in frequency bands used by passive EO missions, and by Earth stations for Space exploration and EO data downlink. These models are used for radio regulation frequency sharing analyses to determine the compatibility of services using radio spectrum. The frequency sharing analyses have specific needs, stemming from the considered system configuration (e.g. use of active antennas, coverage area etc.)On the other hand, clutter models can be relatively complex, as they depend on several system and stochastic parameters (e.g. frequency, elevation angle, height of the ground transmitter, characteristics of the clutter environment etc.). Therefore there is the needto improve clutter propagation models and to define their usage in to frequency sharing methods. To address this, this activity improves clutter loss models and defines the methods and the requirements for their use by frequency management engineers in system simulations to assess the compatibility of different radio services of the radio regulations and to perform the respective studies. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - State-of-the-art review and development plan, - Clutter model improvement and implementation, - Design and Implementation of system simulation for test-cases for sharing analyses, - Execution and analysis of test cases- Inputs for radio regulations and Conclusions Software shall be delivered under an ESA Software Community Licence, so that any individuals or entities within ESA Member States can access to it and can provide update to the community of users.Procurement Policy: C(2) = A relevant participation (in terms of quality and quantity) of non-primes (incl. SMEs) is required. title: Aankoop en levering van een humanoid robot en toebehoren (EFRO)
description: Context: Het voorwerp van deze overheidsopdracht betreft de levering, installatie en indienststelling van een humanoid robot met toebehoren, bestemd voor gebruik binnen onderzoek, ontwikkeling, demonstratie, disseminatie en valorisatie. De robot zal ingezet worden bij meerdere projecten, waaronder: • EFRO Digital Health, • Strategisch Dossier Mechatronics (PWO), • Embodied AI for Industry • VIVES brede disseminatie en valorisatieactiviteiten. Gezien het onderzoeks- en innovatiekarakter van deze projecten is het essentieel dat de robot inzetbaar is als open ontwikkelplatform, zonder vendor lock in, en met ruime mogelijkheden voor integratie, simulatie en eigen algoritme ontwikkeling. Voorwerp van deze levering: De opdracht omvat de levering van een humanoid robot, met onder meer volgende hoofdcomponenten: • een hoofd uitgerust met sensoren voor navigatie en perceptie (zoals LiDAR en 3D-/dieptecamera’s), • een romp met controle- en rekeneenheden en een batterij, • twee armen, elk voorzien van een hand met minstens drie actueerbare vingers, • twee benen met twee voeten. De robot zal worden ingezet in een onderzoek omgeving en niet in een productieomgeving. Dit impliceert een gebruik dat gekenmerkt wordt door experimentele toepassingen en niet‑continue werking, wat doorgaans gepaard gaat met een beperktere mechanische belasting en slijtage dan bij industriële productieprocessen. Het gebruik van de robot is beperkt tot een gecontroleerde onderzoek omgeving, onder toezicht van bevoegde medewerkers van de aanbestedende overheid. Gezien het onderzoeks- en innovatiekarakter van de opdracht behoudt de aanbestedende overheid zich de mogelijkheid voor om na gunning van de opdracht bijkomende uitbreidingen of aanvullende leveringen te overwegen. Leveringsplaats: Katholieke Hogeschool Vives Noord vzw T.a.v. Jonas Lannoo Xaverianenstraat 10 - 8200 Brugge. CPV code: 42997300-4 Industriële robots

title: Mapovanie biotopov a druhov živočíchov vo vybraných ÚEV
description: Predmetom zákazky je zmapovanie vybraných biotopov a skupín živočíchov vo vybraných územiach európskeho významu (ďalej len "ÚEV") pre účely vypracovania dokumentov starostlivosti. Podrobný zoznam biotopov a vybraných skupín živočíšnych druhov, ktoré sú predmetom mapovania v jednotlivých ÚEV je v Prílohe č. 1 súťažných podkladov. Je členený po jednotlivých častiach zákazky, ktorými sú lesné biotopy, nelesné biotopy, mäkkýše, hmyz, ryby, obojživelníky, netopiere. Súčasťou zoznamu je rozdelenie ÚEV podľa priorít od 1 po 3, pričom v roku 2026 je potrebné zrealizovať mapovanie v ÚEV s prioritou 1 a min. v 2/3 ÚEV s prioritou 2 a v roku 2027 realizovať mapovanie vo zvyšných ÚEV s prioritou 2 a v ÚEV s prioritou 3. Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky tvorí prílohu č. 1 súťažných podkladov. Predmetom mapovania je výskyt cieľových druhov živočíchov (netopiere) v územiach európskeho významu (ÚEV). Zhotoviteľ identifikuje potenciálne biotopy týchto druhov, vytvára inventarizačné lokality podľa metodiky a vykonáva terénny zber údajov vrátane sprievodných druhov. title: BEYOND 5G HUB OVER-THE-AIR VERTICAL SEGMENT VALIDATIONS (ARTES 4.0 5G/6G 3F.062) - EXPRO+
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to develop and test integrated satellite-terrestrial solutions for Beyond 5G (B5G) use cases. To deliver such solutions, the activity will developsystem demonstrators that will validate B5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) solutions in realistic operational conditions, using over-the-air field trials.TargetedImprovements:Enabling the adoption of satellite by B5G verticals.Description: The prospect of satellite in B5G is far-reaching. B5G and in particular B5G NTN will build onthe capabilities of today s 5G networks and services, including those enabled byfuture 5G-Advanced and 6G. However, capitalising on this new opportunity will require satcom stakeholders to overcome many challenges, such as demonstrating thetechnical validity ofB5G NTN solutions under specific operational environments while fulfilling industries requirements, and understanding how to natively integrate future 6GNTN services in the operations of these industries. Building and launching B5G NTN infrastructure and services involves complex, time consuming and costly transformationalprojects at every level of satellite and terrestrial systems.To fillthis gap, this activity will develop, validate and demonstrate B5G NTN solutions for various vertical markets, including direct-to-device, IoT, automotive, transportation,maritime, health, energy, agriculture and emergency response. It will consolidate industrial requirements that will translate into the technical specifications of systemdemonstrators. Demonstrations will use existing spacesegment. The developments will leverage on leading industrial solutions and open-source technologies wheneverpossible, to support diverse requirements of market verticals, with guaranteed Quality of Service (QoS) and other connectivity enablers as required. These will coveradaptations and enhancements of edge nodes, user equipment and network implementations to integrate satellite. The resulting systems will be validated and demonstratedusing over-the-air field trials allowing the concerned verticals to verify the performance of B5G NTN in a realistic operational conditions of their use cases.The activity will seek synergies with ARTES deliverables, testbeds, hubs, and in-orbit experiments, as well as with various European and national projects that are beingdeveloped.

title: INCUBED CALL FOR PROPOSAL: STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS
description: The InCubed Element of the European Earth Watch Programme (InCubed) aims to accompany European economic operators in the rapid evolution of the Earth Observation market, both in Europe and globally. InCubed introduces a dedicated process within ESA Earth Observation programmes to strengthen and stimulate the development of near-to-market commercial initiatives in partnership with industry. Activities supported under InCubed include the development and/or demonstration of space assets (e.g. missions, instruments, prototype elements of EO constellations), innovative mission management solutions (including for future EO constellations), as well as the development of ground, data, and application platforms. InCubed targets commercial viability by the end of the activity (at least at minimum viable product level) and requires a substantial degree of innovation, i.e. the creation of new value within the EO commercial landscape. Commercial customer engagement is mandatory, with customers acting as beta testers and validators of the developed product or service. Customer engagement must be clearly demonstrated at both pitch and proposal stages, and letters of support or interest from potential customers are considered a strong asset. The scope of the proposed activities is defined by the economic operators themselves, in line with the objectives of InCubed. Two development cycles are available within InCubed, depending on the maturity of the concept: De-risking Cycle (typically starting from TRL 4), focusing on reducing technical and market risks;Product Development Cycle (typically starting from TRL 6), aiming at delivering a product ready for commercialisation. Under this Call for Proposals, economic operators are invited to submit their ideas via the OSIP (Open Space Innovation Platform) (ideas.esa.int), which serves as the entry point for the programme. The application process consists of the following step: Idea Pitch - Applicantssubmit and present a draft Outline proposal via OSIP to ESA (and potentially the relevant National Delegation(s)). Following a positive assessment, economic operators will be invited to submit a Proposal Part 2 (Full) in accordance with the established procedures and evaluation criteria. Activities supported under InCubed are based on a co-funding scheme, whereby economic operators contribute financially to the project, demonstrating commitment to and confidence in their business case.
